verdict.rationale: Aleph documents bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows, including push sync and reporting automation, and add-ins that keep reporting packages in sync. That covers getting report data into spreadsheet formats. Nothing in the pack mentions exporting to slides (e.g., PowerPoint/Google Slides) or PDF. Missing for 10: slide/deck export, PDF export, explicit report-export documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
